verdict.rationale: SES documents monitoring of bounce, complaint and reject rates, and its Virtual Deliverability Manager provides deliverability insights and recommendations aimed at improving inbox placement. That covers the core of the story beyond raw counts. However, the evidence is FAQ-level, and engagement analytics such as opens and clicks are not explicitly documented. A community user notes having to build delivery reports themselves, though this does not concretely contradict Virtual Deliverability Manager. Missing for 10: explicit engagement (open/click) analytics documentation, in-depth docs on Virtual Deliverability Manager reputation guidance and inbox-placement metrics, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a deliverability manager, I can see bounce, complaint, and engagement analytics with guidance on inbox placement and sender reputation, not just raw counts

citations.quote: These monitoring methods assist you in keeping track of important measures, such as your account's bounce, complaint and reject rates.
With Virtual Deliverability Manager, email senders are able to track their email deliverability through deliverability insights and improve email inbox placement
Email senders can also enable Virtual Deliverability Manager to automatically implement recommendations that instantly improve their email deliverability.
